t: 诺森布里亚国王埃德温由约克主教保利努斯皈依基督教.
te: King Edwin of Northumbria is converted to Christianity by Paulinus, Bishop of York.

t: 赫拉克利乌斯皇帝手下的一支拜占庭军队击败了由拉赫扎德将军指挥的皇帝克斯劳二世的波斯军队.
te: A Byzantine army under Emperor Heraclius defeats Emperor Khosrau II's Persian forces, commanded by General Rhahzadh.
dz: 尼尼微之战:赫拉克利乌斯皇帝手下的一支拜占庭军队击败了由拉赫扎德将军指挥的皇帝克斯劳二世的波斯军队.
de: Battle of Nineveh: A Byzantine army under Emperor Heraclius defeats Emperor Khosrau II's Persian forces, commanded by General Rhahzadh.
